priorities.name: Quiet, private space for meeting-heavy and technical work
priorities.issue: Managers spend the day in back-to-back calls with nowhere private to take them, and the shift to smaller, clustered cubes has made focused technical work harder.
whatItLooksLike: no privacy with ongoing all day meetings and calls
The change from professional cubes to much smaller, highly clustered cubes make it very difficult to focus on technical work.

evidence.text: Focused / Private Work is the #1 priority category (80/100); focused-space friction 34/100 (61% under-supported).
Noise & Distraction: 137 comments (64% neg); Privacy & Confidentiality: 124 comments (60% neg); Focus/Concentration: 96 (55%).

priorities.proposedAction: Assess enclosed/manager-suitable space and the cube-density change against demand; validate whether zoning or added enclosed rooms is warranted before build-out.
priorities.siteMustDo: Walk the floor at peak, quantify where private space runs out, and bring a sized gap (including the cube-density concern) to Workplace Solutions.

priorities.name: Manager workstations with monitors and a door
priorities.issue: Enclosed workstations equipped with monitors are scarce for managers who need them, and desk equipment is unreliable.
whatItLooksLike: The availability of workspaces with monitors and a door is limited for managers.
The limited areas to work when you have meetings that others should not hear. Not always able to sit in the same seat.

evidence.text: Hardware: 115 comments, 56% negative; Technology priority score 56/100.

priorities.proposedAction: Map demand for enclosed, monitor-equipped workstations and standardize desk equipment/checks.
priorities.siteMustDo: Quantify how many enclosed monitor-equipped seats are needed vs. available and route to Workplace Solutions.

priorities.name: Connectivity reliability
priorities.issue: Connectivity is a frequent and highly negative complaint.
whatItLooksLike: Connectivity is the most-negative technology theme at the site (see comment appendix).
priorities.proposedAction: Validate coverage/reliability in the reported areas and route to Technology.
priorities.siteMustDo: Log dead spots and times and escalate to Technology with locations.

priorities.name: Thermal comfort (temperature)
priorities.issue: Parts of the office run cold year-round, and comments say repeated facilities adjustments haven't held — pointing to a zoning or equipment cause rather than the set-point.
whatItLooksLike: Temperature - It is freezing year-round. It's as if the A/C is cranked on by 8:30am. I wear gloves and a jacket in the middle of summer! …

The temperature in our Neighborhood is not comfortable. Facilities has tried over and over again to keep it regulated, however, those of us who are here 5 days a week are always cold and using blankets to keep ourselves warm.
the temperature. It is always freezing in the office.

evidence.text: Thermal / temperature comfort: Under Supported — friction 19/100 (43% under-supported).

priorities.proposedAction: Commission an HVAC zoning and balancing check for the affected neighborhoods, since set-point changes haven't held.
priorities.siteMustDo: Identify the cold neighborhoods and times, request the zoning/balancing check, and verify the result over four weeks.

priorities.name: Meeting-room booking discipline and in-room connections
priorities.issue: Huddle and meeting rooms are booked for the whole day by one person who uses them for an hour or two, and connecting to the room screens is difficult.
whatItLooksLike: People shouldn't be allowed to reserve Huddle meeting rooms or the Hybrid Huddle meeting rooms for the entire workday. I often find it difficult to find space when I need to take meetings in a more private setting.
…Allowing associates to book a meeting room for an entire day for just one person and than they only stay 1-2 hours levaing that space wasted for the day
It is very difficult to connect into the meeting/huddle rooms to the screens, etc and other technology.

evidence.text: Meeting & Conference Rooms: 58 comments, 50% negative; AV / Video Conferencing: 35 comments, 46% negative.
Virtual collaboration with remote/hybrid colleagues: Under Supported — friction 21/100 (44% under-supported).
Availability of meeting & collaboration spaces: on Target — friction 8/100 (18% under-supported).
Room supply rates well; the loss is in all-day single-person bookings and room tech.

priorities.proposedAction: Turn on check-in with auto-release for huddle and meeting rooms, limit all-day single-person bookings, and have Technology test and fix the screen connections in every room.
priorities.siteMustDo: Pull a two-week sample of room bookings vs. actual use, pilot the auto-release rule, and log room-connection failures for Technology.
